errors.evidence: The description states that the horizontal axis has a range, a '%' label, and 10-unit intervals. However, the chart does not have a visible horizontal axis with tick marks, a label, or a defined range; it only shows the numerical values at the end of each bar.
The description states that the vertical axis contains six sentences, but there are seven distinct categories (stereotypes) listed, numbered 7, 10, 11, 12, 13, 14, and 15.
